question: In the context of a Microsoft Excel sheet, what does the term 'workbook' mean?

options.text: A single sheet within a file

solution:
The correct answer is __**The entire Microsoft Excel file**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **workbook** in Microsoft Excel refers to the **entire Excel file**.
 
• A workbook can contain multiple **worksheets**, each represented by a tab at the bottom of the Excel window.
 
• Worksheets within a workbook are used to organize and manage related data in a single file.
 
• Workbooks can include data, charts, graphs, and formulas across multiple worksheets.
 
• Excel workbooks are saved with the extension **.xlsx** or **.xls** (for older versions).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Microsoft Excel is a widely used spreadsheet application developed by Microsoft.
 
• It is part of the Microsoft Office suite and is available for both Windows and macOS.
 
• Excel is used for data analysis, financial modeling, and many other types of quantitative analysis.
 
• Excel supports a wide range of functions and formulas for performing complex calculations.
 
• Excel also offers features like pivot tables, conditional formatting, and data visualization tools.
